author: cHaZzAKAcZ
quote: GTA IV – An absolute masterpiece and pure, unfiltered **** this day, GTA IV remains the best entry in the entire franchise for me. Everything about it just works: an uncompromising, gritty, and mature story without any forced nonsense – and with Niko Bellic, one of the greatest, most authentic protagonists ever written for a video game. A man with rough edges and a real past who walks his own path instead of being forced into some artificial **** top of that, the Euphoria physics engine is still unmatched: every shootout, every crash, and every movement feels heavy, real, and unpredictable. Liberty City feels alive and gives you total freedom to do whatever you want. You can date who you choose, build relationships on your own terms, and experience the world completely by your own **** PC with mouse and keyboard – and especially with the legendary modding community – this game is immortal. This is the exact reason I’ve loved gaming for over 30 years. A timeless classic that no modern entry can touch.

author: cHaZzAKAcZ
quote: I’m writing a review for GTA 6. I can’t just kill everything like in previous games – not that I’d necessarily want to, but the sheer fact that you can’t... that’s not GTA. It’s completely woke, an utterly disgusting story with all this romance nonsense, and it feels super linear. I can’t date whoever I want or build relationships with characters I’m actually interested in.Lucia completely pisses me off – at the same time, I feel bad for her being picked for this role, because in real life it’ll probably leave her with lasting issues. She got used and deserves endless compensation. Jason looks like Arthur, but Jason is no Arthur. Only the PC version and the modding community can save this game, because the physics, graphics, and everything around it definitely have potential – yet they turned it into a worst-case **** best thing about this game is that Niko Bellic is in it. I want to play as Niko, thank goodness his model exists. Rewriting the entire story will be an art form in itself, but I really hope that becomes possible on PC, because I’m not wasting a single second of my time in a story where I constantly have to play dad to a brat who wasn’t likable for a single second.I won’t even get into what it’s like for a PC player to play GTA on a console – that was the worst experience ever. That has nothing to do with pure gaming; if that were gaming, I never would’ve become a gamer – and I’ve been one for over 30 years. I could write a book about how badly this game disappointed me. I want to play this game so badly, but I can’t – things I have zero interest in are being forced on me. GTA is trying to change my mindset, but I will never like this broken world. A woman who plays with guns like a man, abandons her child, and goes off to rob a bank is a goddamn terrible mother, thats not cool and it never will be. Wash my dishes!
